subkind.description: Indicates the content of this message

content_id.description: Unique identifier for this message, used for tracking announcement completion

announcement.description: The message to announce via TTS (subkind=announcement)

faction.description: Optional faction name to select TTS voice accent (subkind=announcement)

source.description: Which TTS source completed playback: gwent, gwent-tui (subkind=announcement_complete)

original_content_id.description: The content_id of the original announcement that completed (subkind=announcement_complete)

effect.description: The sound effect category to play: close, ranged, siege, commander, leader, card, weather, special, ui (subkind=effect)

music.description: The music file to play (without extension). If omitted with random=true, picks random track (subkind=music)

random.description: If true, plays a random background track (subkind=music)
